name: CIMA GR frameset

editorial.verdict: One of the closest practical lightweight aero choices with 50C clearance, but its 425 mm stays and longer wheelbase are race-gravel geometry rather than literal road geometry.
caveats: No meaningful long-term owner evidence yet
Race-gravel handling dimensions rather than a road-race chassis

included: internal tool bag; confirm axle and selected cockpit contents
purchase_route: Current manufacturer storefront lists the exact CIMA GR frameset at US$1,999 in Sailfish Pearl or Sahara Nude through its WooCommerce purchase flow. Confirm selected finish, stock, mainland delivery, taxes and warranty handling before payment.
